name: Candi Prasada
sam3_prompt: tall Balinese brick temple tower with tiered roof
description: A brick prasada rising about 17.2 metres above the grounds of Pura Purusada. Its stepped tower form gives the temple landscape a strong vertical centre.
history: The prasada is one of the key archaeological remains at Pura Purusada Kapal. It has served as a place of worship and a protected home for pratima — sacred images and objects.
cultural_meaning: Here, architecture holds both devotion and care. The tower marks a sacred place while sheltering objects entrusted to the temple community.
location: Pura Purusada, Desa Kapal, Kecamatan Mengwi, Kabupaten Badung, Bali, Indonesia
material: Brick, with timber, thatch and stone details

sources.title: Inventarisasi Cagar Budaya di Desa Kapal - Balai Pelestarian Cagar Budaya Bali
